summary: Chilean Cobalt Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of 1,562,500 common shares at $1.60/share (aggregate $2.5M) to existing investors Glencore plc and Madesal SpA. The offering is exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506 of Regulation D. Proceeds will fund district consolidation, exploration, ESG work, and general corporate purposes. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexities (collateral, overhang, premium) are cited. This is a routine capital raise without any special-situation attributes such as a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. What to watch: future dilution and use of proceeds; no risk-arb angle given non-event nature.
